sourceModelSummary.model_purpose: Models the RIIO-2 price control financial performance of National Grid Electricity System Operator (NGESO), including RAV rollforward, financeability ratios, allowed revenue, and return on regulatory equity (RoRE) under different cost and financing scenarios
sourceModelSummary.industry: electricity transmission system operation (UK energy regulation)
sourceModelSummary.timeline: Historic RIIO-1 data (circa 2011-2021) feeding into RIIO-2 price control period modelled from Mar 2022 through at least Mar 2026, with named year references like Mar 2022_42 suggesting a longer underlying timeline
key_drivers: Totex (capex and opex) scenario selection (company proposal vs Ofgem FD vs Ofgem DD)
Cost of debt and cost of equity assumptions
RoRE (Return on Regulatory Equity) performance and incentive outcomes

sheet_map.Cover: Title page identifying the model as Ofgem/NGESO RIIO-2 Licence Model (LiMo) for the Electricity System Operator
sheet_map.UserInterface: User-facing control sheet for selecting the model year and operating the model
sheet_map.Model Map: Navigation aid showing high-level structure separating Input, Calculation, and Financial Analysis sections
sheet_map.FinancialStatements: Core RAV, net debt, and equity rollforward producing closing balance sheet items with a balancing check row
sheet_map.FinancialRatios: Calculates financeability ratios such as FFO interest cover and adjusted (post-maintenance) interest cover ratio
sheet_map.FinRatios RoRE decomposition: Breaks down revenue into fast money, pass-through, depreciation, financing return, and incentive components for RoRE analysis
sheet_map.RatingSimulator: Implements a credit rating scorecard tool based on Moodys regulated utility methodology, scoring regulatory and business risk factors
sheet_map.OutputSummary: Live summary of key financeability metrics (CFO/interest, CFO/debt, debt/capitalisation, net debt/RAV, net debt/EBITDA)
sheet_map.ScenarioRun_AllOutputData: Control sheet and data store capturing output across multiple modelling and financeability scenarios with timestamps
sheet_map.RoRE ranges: Shows allowed RoRE, minimum/maximum RoRE ranges, and NPV-neutral RAV return base across the price control
sheet_map.Tables: Summary reference tables combining totex, revenue, capitalisation, and RoRE figures, including historic RIIO-1 data
sheet_map.LiveResults: Live calculation output of the PCFM for the currently selected company/scenario used for saving or reporting
sheet_map.SavedResults: Stored/archived historic results linked to specific saved scenario runs with timestamps and version references
sheet_map.SystemOperator: Input sheet containing allowed and actual capex/opex plus business rates and working capital funding
sheet_map.AR: Calculates allowed and calculated revenue (AR) including AIP adjustment terms in nominal and real price terms
sheet_map.NGESO (Scenarios): Scenario selector and key cost of capital inputs (risk free rate, equity beta, total market return, price scaling factor)
sheet_map.CA active scenario: Active cost assessment scenario sheet pulling selected totex, NIA, business rates, and pension deficit charge inputs
sheet_map.ESO Company Proposal: Cost assessment scenario 1a representing the company (NGESO) proposed capex/opex forecast
sheet_map.Ofgem FD Forecast: Cost assessment scenario 2a representing Ofgems Final Determination baseline totex forecast
sheet_map.Ofgem DD Forecast: Cost assessment scenario 2b representing a high totex (Draft Determination) forecast variant
sheet_map.RIIO-1 revenue and charges: Historic RIIO-1 period revenue and charge build-up (fast money, pass-through, depreciation, return) used as a bridge into RIIO-2

immediate_observations: Cost of debt in NGESO (Scenarios) and ScenarioRun_AllOutputData is shown as negative (e.g. -0.00173), reflecting negative real rates circa 2020 but worth confirming sign convention is intentional

Column headers are inconsistent and appear to be generic placeholders (col6, col7, col8, Mar 2022_42) in many sheets, suggesting the underlying Excel structure has merged cells or hidden headers not fully captured
The FinancialStatements Check row is not exactly zero (e.g. 1.25e-12) which is floating point rounding noise rather than a real imbalance, but should be confirmed as immaterial

Multiple competing totex scenarios exist (ESO Company Proposal, Ofgem FD Forecast, Ofgem DD Forecast) and CA active scenario pulls from a selected one via a scenario index - the selection logic and consistency with ScenarioRun outputs should be validated
Some RatingSimulator factors have zero weight (e.g. Generation and Fuel Diversity) which may be appropriate for a System Operator but should be confirmed against the rated methodology
Model mixes nominal (£m nominal) and real/18-19 price (£m 18/19 prices) figures across different sheets which increases risk of unit mismatch errors if not carefully reconciled
sourceModelSummary.validation_focus: Reconcile RAV, net debt, and equity rollforward consistency in FinancialStatements; verify scenario selection flow from CA active scenario through to FinancialStatements, OutputSummary and RoRE ranges; check nominal vs real (18/19 prices) unit consistency across AR, SystemOperator, and revenue sheets; validate cost of capital inputs (cost of debt, cost of equity, gearing) feed correctly into FFO and RoRE calculations; confirm the balancing Check row and any floating point residuals are immaterial
